description: iPhone screenshot of the Q-drop aggregator qmap.pub displaying a Q post whose attached image (labeled TT.png) shows an IWC Schaffhausen chronograph wristwatch and a black textured pen lying on a blank lined notebook page, with a large black area below the photo. description: Q 'proof' graphic juxtaposing the two IWC watch-and-pen photos posted by Q ('Watch #1: 3:15, Posted Jan 5, 2019' and 'Watch #2: 3:42, Posted March 2, 2019') with a screenshot of a POTUS_Schedule (@45_Schedule) tweet stating that Attorney General William Barr authorized the Declaration of a National Emergency on the Southern Border in the Oval Office at 3:42 PM EST on March 15, 2019. Red arrows link the watch times to the tweet, and blue caption text asks 'HOW DID Q KNOW??????'. The graphic claims the 3:42 watch time predicted the Barr authorization; this is presented as the maker's claim, not fact.
text: Watch #1: 3:15. Posted Jan 5, 2019. Watch #2: 3:42. Posted March 2, 2019. POTUS_Schedule. @45_Schedule. Follow. March 15, 2019: Declaration of a National Emergency on the Southern Border was authorized by US Attorney General William Barr in the Oval Office at 3:42 PM EST. 3:48 PM - 15 Mar 2019. 1,006 Retweets. 1,753 Likes. 494. 1.0K. 1.8K. HOW DID Q KNOW??????
flags: Unverified 'Q proof' claim: the graphic asserts the watch photo predicted the Barr authorization time; coincidence/claim not endorsed

description: Conspiracy collage linking the March 2019 Christchurch, New Zealand mosque shootings to John Podesta. It stacks a news headline about New Zealand changing gun laws after the shooting, a photo of the shooter's rifle covered in white-lettered names and slogans, a headline stating Podesta visited New Zealand five days earlier warning of a 'major' cyber-attack, and a widely circulated photo of Podesta holding up his palms marked '14' and a fish drawing. Red circles and arrows connect a '14' and a symbol on the rifle to Podesta's palms, and a side panel recounts the Osiris myth (body cut into 14 pieces, phallus eaten by fish) to imply occult symbolism. The implied Podesta-shooting connection is the collage maker's claim and is not supported by evidence.
text: New Zealand to Change Gun Laws After Mass Shooting Kills 49. By Tracy Withers. March 14, 2019, 33 PM EDT. Updated on March 15, 2019, 9:18 PM EDT. Anton Lundin Pettersson. Ode the Great. Vienne. Skanderbeg. REFUGEES WELCOME TO HELL. Charles Martel. Tours 732. 14. John Podesta Was in New Zealand 5 Days Ago. Warned of 'Major' Cyber-Attack. March 15, 2019. Sean Adl-Tabatabai. News, US. Former Clinton campaign manager, John Podesta, paid a visit to New Zealand four days before the deadly mass shooting to warn of an imminent "major" cyber-attack. In an interview with Newshub, the political hack warned that New Zealand is a "big juicy target" for a cyber-attack by Russia or China. Msn.com reports: Having run the White House as chief of staff to President Bill Clinton, and acting as counsellor to President Barack Obama, Mr Podesta is one of the most powerful people in US democratic politics. He was also the campaign manager of presidential hopeful Hillary Clinton - although that didn't go well. 14 + fish and the Osiris myth. Osiris was murdered and cut up into 14 pieces by his brother Set and scattered throughout the land of Egypt. Osiris's wife Isis set out to find all of the pieces of his body to resurrect him. She found all but the 14th piece, his phallus, which was eaten by fish (now cursed because of this) in the river Nile. Isis made a phallus out of gold and temporary resurrected Osiris so she could conceive a child. Their offspring is the god Horus. 14 + fish = the male phallus symbolizing power, sex magick and resurrection.
flags: Unverified conspiracy claim: collage implies Podesta's visit and palm markings are connected to the Christchurch shooting — no evidence supports this
Second headline is from Sean Adl-Tabatabai (NewsPunch/YourNewsWire), a known fake-news outlet
Names/slogans on the rifle reference prior attackers and historical anti-Muslim battles; some small text illegible
Depicts material related to a mass-casualty terror attack
